Rashi on Menachot 87b:1:1.hebrew: מחוק שבו היה מודד חביתי כ"ג - לפי שיש לו לחלק בשני חצאי עשרון, ואם היה גדוש, כשהיה מטלטלו לחצותו היה מתפזר על גבי קרקע:
Rashi on Menachot 87b:1:1.english: The level [tool] with which he would measure the griddle-cakes of the High Priest - Because he had to divide it into two half-tenths, and if it were heaped, when he would move it in order to divide it, it would scatter onto the ground.
